note: Facade fingerprints read off photographs of each building (scripts/build_facade_fingerprints.py, smc.facades.fingerprint): l/s/h the wall's median colour as lightness, saturation, hue; g the glazing share; t the texture; sd the lightness spread; rows/cols the storey and bay rhythm per metre; n views; frames the photographs used. Matched to the page's renders by smc.facades.match at build time.
